English A2 is confirmed. Written work with a London-based team relies on translation tools; do not describe written or spoken English as fluent.
Henry March-August 2022 is retained from the supplied PDF and used consistently across website and generated CVs.

The Next.js 14 migration and 30% performance improvement are claims supplied in the original CV, retained here rather than independently measured. The author corrected traffic volume to an average of 2,000 users per hour.

The supplied 30% performance claim is preserved; the measurement, baseline and method remain to be clarified with the author.
